answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 150704 Country: india Title: Can I give zakah in advance? If I can so when I will calculate zakah the money I gave in advance will be added in my total wealth while calculating zakah? Question: Can I give zakah in advance? If I can so when I will calculate zakah the money I gave in advance will be added in my total wealth while calculating zakah? Answer ID: 150704 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1085/1100/L=9/1438) You may pay the zakah of the nisab money before one year completes over it and when you calculate the zakah after passing the year then deduct the amount of zakah which you have already paid. It is not necessary to pay its zakah of again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
